theorem L3 (n : Nat) : 2 * ps_t n = n * (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show 2 * ps_t (n + 1) = (n + 1) * (n + 2)
    simp only [ps_t]
    omega

theorem L4 (n : Nat) : ps_d (n + 1) = ps_t n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show ps_d (n + 1 + 1) = ps_t (n + 1)
    rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega]
    simp only [ps_d]
    rw [ih]
    simp only [ps_t]
    omega
